Finding: Single-view reprojection falsely displayed zero
Correction: Represent unavailable cross-view error as null/N/A, including old scorecards
Validation: Scorecard export and frozen single-camera smoke

Finding: Offline model, provider, height and movement controls were bypassed
Correction: Dedicated adapters and one shared offline pipeline with actual provider metadata
Validation: Coordinate/height/in-place tests; CUDA and forced CPU checks

Finding: RTMW3D crop XY could be mistaken for metric XYZ
Correction: Use native XY rays with root-relative metric depth and explicit estimated scale
Validation: Synthetic camera-unit/axes round trip

Finding: Manual single-view edits and hand ROI overrides were rejected
Correction: Apply review points/exclusions/ROIs/depth targets before anatomical fitting
Validation: Manual pin, range/cache and source identity regressions

Finding: Raw saved previews could replace a newer tracker or fresh ROI
Correction: Apply only explicitly tagged, asset-matched review detections
Validation: Preview-vs-correction identity regression

Finding: Quaternion signs produced severe Blender midpoint flips
Correction: Enforce hemispheres after IK/wrist fitting and on body/finger import
Validation: All 8218 key poses and 8215 midpoints through Blender MCP

Finding: Motion-only FBX omitted a skeleton rest/bind pose
Correction: Emit an explicit bind pose using the bundled FBX writer
Validation: Real motion-only FBX deformation/hierarchy round trip

Finding: Fractional-rate FBX comparison sampled the wrong imported key times
Correction: Account for Blender 5.2 FBX key-time units; verify physical duration
Validation: 29.97 FPS and real 30.0578 FPS export tests

Finding: Full cache reload repeatedly decompressed arrays per frame
Correction: Materialize each compressed member once
Validation: One-read regression; 3019-frame cache measured at about 0.105 s

Finding: CUDA exhaustive search delayed first inference
Correction: Configure bounded CPU pools and heuristic CUDA convolution selection
Validation: Actual RTMW3D CUDA benchmark

Finding: Hand crops could target another wrist or inflate tiny-hand confidence
Correction: Reject wrong-wrist geometry and downweight native palm size/overlap
Validation: Wrong-wrist and tiny-palm regressions

Finding: Hand-disabled solves could still execute saved ROI jobs
Correction: Skip ROI inference when finger capture is disabled
Validation: Forbidden-ROI regression

Finding: Progress reached 100 percent before cleanup and publishing
Correction: Map real solve/physics/save stages and check cancellation during CPU cleanup
Validation: Cancellation rollback test; staged progress in benchmark logs

Finding: Deep character contacts were limited to short repair steps
Correction: Use bounded penetration-sized steps and preserve earlier accepted iterations
Validation: Actual 131st pose improved from 68.6 mm to 29.0 mm; rollback regression

Finding: Old uncertainty bands survived source replacement
Correction: Clear timeline evidence when replacing a source
Validation: Workspace source reset and packaged review checks

Finding: Container duration could hide the last native review frames
Correction: Extend review bounds using saved native presentation times
Validation: Nonzero-stream-origin timeline regression

Finding: Camera 03 retains uncertain foot placement
Correction: Expose Grade C and uncertain intervals for manual review
Validation: Final estimated stance drift 17.50 mm; not ground-truth error

Finding: Selected character retains some surface contacts after repair
Correction: Retain editable correction copy and report sampled residuals
Validation: 239-frame repair plus 477 sampled integer/half pose contact checks

Finding: Absolute monocular accuracy and hidden fingers lack reference labels
Correction: Require labeled gestures/reference capture before claiming accuracy
Validation: Current confidence/continuity metrics do not measure reference accuracy
